articles.headline: UEFA stands by World Cup boycott plans despite FIFA, Gianni Infantino apology
articles.description: UEFA has said its participating members could still boycott FIFA competitions including the World Cup despite Gianni Infantino's apology statement.

articles.headline: CAF's silence is deafening, but Africa can be swing vote in FIFA's Infantino saga
articles.description: Since Gianni Infantino's plan to 'sell the FIFA World Cup' scandal first broke, the Confederation of African Football has been conspicuous by its silence.

articles.headline: English FA maintains that Gianni Infantino wrong president despite FIFA support - report
articles.description: The Football Association continues to believe Gianni Infantino is no longer the right man to lead FIFA despite his own organisation throwing its "full support" behind him on Wednesday night.

articles.headline: Argentina announces commemorative day to celebrate World Cup win over England
articles.description: Argentina's Football Association unanimously approved for July 15 to be 'National Football Teams Day' in commemoration of the Albiceleste's victory over England in the semifinals of the 2026 World Cup.

articles.headline: Spain's sports minister says country 'deserves' to host 2030 World Cup final, not Morocco
articles.description: Spain "deserves" to host the 2030 World Cup final, according to the country's sports minister Milagros Tolón.

articles.headline: Socceroos transfer tracker: Where Australia's stars will play in 2026-27
articles.description: There's nothing like a World Cup to put young stars in the shop window! With that in mind, ESPN has assembled a list of all the Socceroos' post-tournament transfers, all in one place.
